doc.title: Tom Scott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Another Tom Scott: the session trumpeter mix-up at the union
summary: Scott mentions a trumpeter of the same name (Thomas H.) and union check mix-ups in the late 60s.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: The first question I have is rather an easy one: I’ve been reading through the list of your accomplishments in all the fields and I’m wondering is there possibly more than one Tom Scott?

Well not that I know. Actually, seriously, there is still I believe, I believe he’s still alive, a trumpet player, a session trumpet player in L.A. named Tom Scott. He was Thomas H., I’m Thomas W. So when I first started doing sessions in the late 60s, early 70s, there was some mix-up at the union over whose check was whose. So there was a bit of that but I haven’t seen him in decades. I hope he is well. I don’t know.
You probably eventually made more on your checks than him. That’s a guess of mine.
Okay. I won’t dispute that probably I guess.
